description: Build the ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) FoodHerons.Api order service under server/ with two endpoints (POST /api/orders, POST /api/orders/{id}/transition), Supabase JWT validation, service-role Npgsql writes, server-side price/total computation, Asia/Manila openness, the status state machine, the §4 error/validation contract, non-secret config + .env.example + .gitignore updates, and an xUnit test project for the pure logic. This feature is backend-only and fully buildable/testable on its own with NO live Supabase secret. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 (frontend) targets the HTTP contract defined here.
steps: Create server/FoodHerons.sln and server/FoodHerons.Api/FoodHerons.Api.csproj (Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, TargetFramework net10.0, Nullable enable) with package refs Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer and Npgsql; add a minimal Program.cs so it compiles. Add the project to the solution. Verify `dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln`.

Add NON-secret config: server/FoodHerons.Api/appsettings.json (Supabase:Url, Supabase:Issuer, Supabase:Audience=authenticated, empty ConnectionStrings:Postgres placeholder, and Kestrel/Urls = http://localhost:5080); appsettings.Development.json with placeholders only (committed); Properties/launchSettings.json with applicationUrl=http://localhost:5080. Add server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example documenting exact keys: ConnectionStrings__Postgres, Supabase__JwtSecret, Supabase__Url, Supabase__Issuer, Supabase__Audience, optional Supabase__ServiceRoleKey (placeholder values ONLY).

Update root .gitignore to add server/**/bin/, server/**/obj/, server/**/.env, and `!server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example` placed AFTER the existing .env.* line so the template stays tracked while real env/bin/obj stay ignored.

Create DTOs in server/FoodHerons.Api/Dtos/: PlaceOrderRequest { VendorId, PickupName, Note?, Items: LineItemDto[] }, LineItemDto { MenuItemId, Qty } with NO price field anywhere (structurally cannot accept a client price); PlaceOrderResponse { Id (Guid), Code, Status, Subtotal, Total, VendorId, Items (ResponseLine[]), PlacedAt }; ResponseLine { MenuItemId, Name, UnitPrice, Qty }; TransitionRequest { To, Reason? }; OrderDto { Id, Code, Status, VendorId, Subtotal, Total, PlacedAt, AcceptedAt?, ReadyAt?, CompletedAt?, CancelledAt?, CancelReason? }. Use decimal for all money.

Implement server/FoodHerons.Api/Services/OrderService.cs with pure, DB-free logic behind test-stubbable abstractions (menu-price lookup and current-order-status are inputs/interfaces, not direct Npgsql calls): (a) total computation — merge duplicate line ids (sum qty), look up each (vendorId, menuItemId), reject unknown/unavailable with code ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, compute subtotal=total=sum(unit_price*qty) from DB prices; (b) Asia/Manila openness — convert DateTimeOffset.UtcNow to a FIXED UTC+8 offset (no DST, no Windows tz id dependency), format HH:mm, compare to hours_open/hours_close with overnight-wrap (open<=close ? now>=open && now<close : now>=open || now<close), '00:00'/'00:00' => always closed; (c) transition state machine — legal set EXACTLY {pending->preparing, preparing->ready, ready->completed, pending->cancelled, preparing->cancelled}, else ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, classify vendor-action vs student-cancel, student cancel legal only from pending. Add validation helpers: pickupName trim 2-80, note <=280, items 1-50, qty 1-99, reason required iff to='cancelled' and <=140.

Implement server/FoodHerons.Api/Data/Db.cs: an Npgsql connection factory using ConnectionStrings:Postgres (service-role connection, bypasses RLS), plus parameterized DB operations: menu lookup per vendor (name/price/available by menu_item_id), vendor existence + preorder_enabled + hours_open/hours_close + owner_id, single-transaction INSERT into orders (omit code; RETURNING id, code, placed_at) + order_items, and the transition transaction (SELECT status, student_id, vendor_id ... FOR UPDATE; apply if legal; set matching lifecycle timestamp accepted_at/ready_at/completed_at/cancelled_at + cancel_reason on reject; RETURNING the row). Must compile with no live DB.

Implement server/FoodHerons.Api/Auth/SupabaseJwt.cs: a DI extension configuring JwtBearer — default JWKS/asymmetric mode (metadata from ${Supabase:Url}/auth/v1, JWKS at /.well-known/jwks.json) when no Supabase:JwtSecret; HS256 SymmetricSecurityKey mode when the secret is present. Validate issuer ${Supabase:Url}/auth/v1, audience 'authenticated', lifetime, signature. Expose helpers to read sub (user id) and app_metadata.role from the validated principal. Must configure without throwing when no secret is set.

Implement server/FoodHerons.Api/Endpoints/OrdersEndpoints.cs and finalize Program.cs: Minimal API host wiring auth, CORS (dev origin http://localhost:5173 from config so prod can override), DI (OrderService, Db, ILogger), and an /api route group that RequireAuthorization. POST /api/orders: require role student (403 else), force student_id = caller uid, validate vendor exists + preorder_enabled + open-in-Manila (409 VENDOR_CLOSED), run price/total logic (422 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE on unknown/unavailable; 422 + field detail on bad input), INSERT in one txn, return 201 PlaceOrderResponse. POST /api/orders/{id}/transition: load order (404), authorize (vendor owner via vendors.owner_id for vendor moves; order.student_id for student cancel; else 403), apply state machine atomically (409 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION incl. student-cancel lost race), 422 if cancel without reason, return 200 OrderDto. Error contract: machine-readable code on 4xx; 5xx returns a generic body + correlation id (never a stack trace); ILogger at stated levels; no PII beyond order code + user id. NO GET endpoint.

Create server/FoodHerons.Api.Tests/ (FoodHerons.Api.Tests.csproj referencing the API project + xunit + xunit.runner.visualstudio + Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk; add to the solution) with xUnit tests driving OrderService via stubbed menu-lookup/status inputs (NO live Postgres): total computation (server price wins; request DTO has no price field; duplicate line ids merge; unknown item -> ITEM_UNAVAILABLE; unavailable item -> ITEM_UNAVAILABLE); Asia/Manila openness (normal window open+closed; overnight-wrap close<open open+closed on both sides of midnight; '00:00'/'00:00' => closed); transition state machine (every legal forward move allowed; each backward/skip/terminal rejected; student-cancel allowed only while pending); input validation (pickupName <2 and >80 rejected, note >280 rejected, qty 0 and 100 rejected, empty items rejected, cancel-without-reason rejected).
acceptance_criteria: `dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln` succeeds with no errors.
`dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln` passes all tests, covering total computation, Asia/Manila openness incl. overnight-wrap, the transition state machine, and input validation.
The service compiles and the test suite runs with NO live Supabase secret configured.
PlaceOrderRequest/LineItemDto have no price field (client cannot send a price).

appsettings.json contains only non-secret config; appsettings.Development.json and server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example contain placeholders only; no real connection string / JWT secret / service-role key appears in any tracked file.
.gitignore excludes server/**/bin/, server/**/obj/, server/**/.env while keeping server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example tracked.
No SQL under supabase/ is modified.
verification: Run `dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln` from the worktree root and confirm it succeeds.
Run `dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln` and confirm all tests pass.

Grep server/ tracked files + .env.example for real secrets (connection strings with passwords, JWT secrets, service-role keys) and confirm only placeholders; run `git status` and confirm no .env / bin/ / obj/ is staged.
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln succeeds; dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln passes 60/60 (total computation, Asia/Manila openness incl. overnight-wrap, transition state machine, input validation) with NO live Supabase secret. No real secrets in tracked files (placeholders only); git status shows no .env/bin/obj staged (.gitignore covers server/**/bin|obj|.env with the .env.example negation). No SQL under supabase/ modified.

=== HTTP CONTRACT FOR FEAT-002 (frontend) ===
Base: all routes under /api, all REQUIRE a valid Supabase JWT (Authorization: Bearer <access_token> from supabase.auth.getSession().data.session.access_token). Dev service URL http://localhost:5080; add Vite proxy '/api' -> http://localhost:5080. CORS allows http://localhost:5173 (config Cors:Origins). There is NO GET endpoint (reads go direct-to-Supabase under RLS). A /health GET exists (anonymous) returning {"status":"ok"} for liveness only.

ROUTE 1 — POST /api/orders (place order). Caller role must be 'student' (from app_metadata.role) else 403. student_id is forced to the caller's JWT sub (never from body).
  Request JSON (PlaceOrderRequest): { "vendorId": "tita-nenas", "pickupName": "Juan Dela Cruz", "note": "extra sauce"|null, "items": [ { "menuItemId": "tapsilog", "qty": 2 } ] }. NOTE: no price field exists anywhere; client sends only menuItemId + qty. Duplicate menuItemIds are merged (summed). Validation: pickupName 2-80 chars after trim; note <=280; items 1-50 entries; qty 1-99.
  Success 201 (PlaceOrderResponse), Location header /api/orders/{id}: { "id": "<uuid>", "code": "FH-000142", "status": "pending", "subtotal": 175.00, "total": 175.00, "vendorId": "tita-nenas", "items": [ { "menuItemId": "tapsilog", "name": "Tapsilog", "unitPrice": 75.00, "qty": 2 } ], "placedAt": "<ISO-8601>" }. subtotal==total (no fees). Prices/names are server-side DB snapshots.

ROUTE 2 — POST /api/orders/{id}/transition (advance/cancel). {id} is the order UUID (not the display code).
  Request JSON (TransitionRequest): { "to": "preparing", "reason": null }. 'to' must be one of pending|preparing|ready|completed|cancelled. 'reason' is REQUIRED iff to=='cancelled' (<=140 chars) and must be absent/empty otherwise.
  Legal transitions EXACTLY: pending->preparing, preparing->ready, ready->completed, pending->cancelled, preparing->cancelled. (ready->cancelled is ILLEGAL.) Authorization: vendor moves (->preparing/ready/completed and vendor reject->cancelled) require caller == vendors.owner_id; student cancel (pending->cancelled) allowed to the order's student_id (owner also allowed). Student cancel only wins while status is still pending (checked under FOR UPDATE), else 409 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.
  Success 200 (OrderDto): { "id": "<uuid>", "code": "FH-000142", "status": "preparing", "vendorId": "tita-nenas", "subtotal": 175.00, "total": 175.00, "placedAt": "<ISO>", "acceptedAt": "<ISO>"|null, "readyAt": null, "completedAt": null, "cancelledAt": null, "cancelReason": null }. The lifecycle timestamp matching the new status is set: preparing->acceptedAt, ready->readyAt, completed->completedAt, cancelled->cancelledAt(+cancelReason). NOTE: DB/service canonical in-progress status is 'preparing'; OrderStatus.jsx should map preparing -> 'Accepted' label.

ERROR CONTRACT (RFC7807 ProblemDetails JSON with an extra machine-readable "code"): bodies look like { "status": <int>, "title": "<human msg>", "code": "<CODE>", ...extras }.
  401 code=UNAUTHENTICATED (missing/invalid JWT).
  403 code=FORBIDDEN (place: caller not a student; transition: caller not owner/student).
  404 code=NOT_FOUND (transition: order id not found).
  409 code=VENDOR_CLOSED (place: vendor missing, preorder_enabled=false, or closed in Asia/Manila now).
  409 code=ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, extras { "from": "<status>", "to": "<status>" } (skip/backward/terminal move, or student-cancel lost race).
  422 code=ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, extras { "menuItemId": "<id>" } (unknown or unavailable menu item).
  422 code=VALIDATION, extras { "field": "vendorId|pickupName|note|items|to|reason" } (bad input incl. cancel-without-reason).
  500 code=INTERNAL, extras { "correlationId": "<traceId>" } (generic; never a stack trace).

CONFIG/SECRETS: appsettings.json has non-secret config only (Supabase:Url/Issuer/Audience, empty ConnectionStrings:Postgres, Urls=http://localhost:5080). Real secrets via dotnet user-secrets (dev) / env vars (prod): ConnectionStrings__Postgres, Supabase__JwtSecret (HS256 mode) or JWKS auto-derived from Supabase__Url (asymmetric mode, default when no JwtSecret), optional Supabase__ServiceRoleKey. Template at server/FoodHerons.Api/.env.example.

NOTE on solution format: .NET 10 SDK defaults to .slnx; this task's verification commands name FoodHerons.sln, so a classic-format .sln was generated explicitly (dotnet new sln --format sln). Build/test both target server/FoodHerons.sln.
